title: Validate the current manager bundle before publication
objectives: Validate the current manager bundle before publication

tasks.instruction: Use Automation Operations or the ansible01 virtual CLI. New starter files are explicit repository fixture additions; old seed commits remain.

Repair the manager bundle to repFactor=auto, run preflight again and verify current-checksum validation succeeds. Do not publish: validation is independent of deployment.

Review the operation page after Ansible queues asynchronous work.
